items.title: 微軟開源Scope評測平臺，追蹤AI程式開發代理的任務表現
items.summary: 微軟開源評測平臺Scope，可讓GitHub Copilot、Claude Code等AI程式開發代理執行指定任務，檢查是否按照文件正確使用軟體開發套件（SDK）、應用程式介面（API）及相關工具。平臺也會記錄操作過程與測試結果，協助開發團隊找出代理執行任務時遇到的問題。

items.title: 印度數位憑證業者eMudhra中繼CA私密金鑰可被還原，瀏覽器緊急封鎖相關憑證
items.summary: 印度數位憑證業者eMudhra旗下8張中繼憑證授權機構（Certificate Authority，CA）憑證的私密金鑰存在安全問題，研究人員發現，這些金鑰可從公開憑證輕易還原。其中6張中繼CA憑證可用於簽發TLS憑證，攻擊者可能利用相關金鑰偽造HTTPS憑證，冒充合法網站或服務。為防範這類風險，Google、Mozilla及Go程式語言專案已陸續採取防護措施。

items.title: Anthropic取得Opaque機密AI技術與人才
items.summary: 機密AI與可驗證AI技術業者Opaque Systems於10月13日宣布，團隊將加入AI業者Anthropic，公司也將結束營運。

items.title: 防範AI代理越界行為，NIST提出事件應變指引
items.summary: 10月16日美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）與國家安全局（NSA）、網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）共同發布10項AI代理事件應變建議，協助組織防範及處理AI代理的越界行為。這份自願性指引主要針對訓練及評估高度先進AI代理的組織，相關措施也可供部署這類AI代理的組織參考。NIST將指引內容分為準備、偵測、應變、復原及通報5個階段。

items.title: Perplexity開源AI代理沙箱SPACE，強化程式碼執行隔離
items.summary: AI搜尋服務業者Perplexity宣布開源AI代理沙箱平臺SPACE，供其他開發者為AI代理建立隔離的程式碼執行環境，降低AI代理執行不受信任程式碼時影響其他系統的風險。SPACE原本用於Perplexity旗下AI代理服務Computer，該公司自今年7月開始以SPACE取代先前採用的商用沙箱服務。

items.title: ClawRouter: use OpenAI hosted web search when the catalog admits it, …
items.summary: ClawRouter: use OpenAI hosted web search when the catalog admits it, and keep its source links (#179903) * fix(clawrouter): expose and forward catalog-backed Fast tiers * fix(clawrouter): validate tiers after caller payload overrides * feat(clawrouter): enable catalog-admitted hosted web search * fix(clawrouter): keep isolated completions tool-free * fix(providers): type hosted search stream options * fix(ai): preserve annotated Responses snapshot boundaries * fix(ai): keep terminal render merge local * fix(ai): recover citations from collapsed message items * fix(ai): preserve collapse cursor during citation backfill * fix(agents): preserve reply scope for late source backfills * test(clawrouter): couple held image waits to generation settlement * ClawRouter: use OpenAI hosted web search when the catalog admits it, and keep its source links OpenClaw-Publication: 6ad01c8d-31ff-43b5-9dce-19ad2caff970 * fix(ai): keep Responses continuation when replies carry source links Rendered source links are OpenClaw formatting, not provider output. The text signature now records that suffix and replay strips it, so replayed history matches the stored response and previous_response_id continuation (effort updates, tool turns) still engages. Hosted web_search_call items are server-side and are left out of the continuation baseline. * Publish openclaw/claw-hosted-search-native-20261020 OpenClaw-Publication: 63c80197-3b39-4c16-8508-3ff04dbc0a43 * test(ai): give async tool-flow continuation tests an uncited final answer These tests are about tool execution, not sources. The shared completion fixture carries a url_citation, which now renders a source link, so they use an uncited completion and keep their plain-text assertions. * Publish openclaw/claw-hosted-search-native-20261020 OpenClaw-Publication: 0842cef1-4625-4bb6-98a2-8830014aabb7 * refactor(ai): keep the Responses source signature off the Plugin SDK surface The shared encodeTextSignatureV1 is reachable through the Plugin SDK. The `sources` field is a Responses-internal replay detail, so its encoder and updater live in the Responses message-text module and the shared encoder is unchanged from main. * Publish openclaw/claw-hosted-search-native-20261020 OpenClaw-Publication: e2c8db95-f8be-4456-9ccb-246f49a047c9 * Publish openclaw/claw-hosted-search-native-20261020 OpenClaw-Publication: e0e0df4d-e18d-4fa1-a97a-eec27b7a972d
